Query GraphQL tooltip: Write a GraphQL query against the data space's datapoints and sources. Suggestions come from the backend's schema. Only queries are allowed: mutations and subscriptions are blocked.
GraphQL mutations not allowed: Mutations and subscriptions are not allowed here: this mode only runs queries.
